projection.transform: Test-only projection: retain Table 1 rows with area code K02000001 and columns A/B/C/G/H; retain original row values and numeric cells while converting shared strings to inline strings; replace cover with the original edition publication date and synthetic projection title; retain workbook sheet identities with empty Contents/Notes. No original workbook is committed.
projection.growth_precision: Workbook latest UK Annual change cell is stored as 3.8052769999999998 (Excel numeric representation; ONS bulletin headline rounds to one decimal place). Parser explicitly Decimal-quantizes to six decimal places, yielding canonical 3.805277. UI card displays up to four decimals; chart coordinates use this six-decimal canonical value. This is a parser normalization/display choice, not a claim that ONS specifies six-decimal statistical precision.
projection.missing_values: Observed in extracted UK Table 1 G/H cells: [x]. Parser treats [x] and structurally absent observation cells as missing. Empty cell values and [z] were not observed and remain unrecognized, rather than assumed missing tokens.
